analysis.reasonEn: RSI has exited oversold but remains in neutral territory. MACD histogram shows improvement but is still negative. The price is near the 5-day low support ($581.25), maintaining a higher level than the 20-day low ($524.49). Significantly lower volume compared to the 5-day average reduces the conviction of current moves. Therefore, maintaining a wait-and-see approach.
